title: mbooloo mi réer
intro: Yaa ngi taxaw ci kanamu echo askan wuñ bind jaar-jaaram ci vague yi. Ruuh yooyu dégg nañu woote, tànn bañ, daal di jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu soppi jëmmu suuf si. Ñoom ñooy kan, te lu xew ci seen àdduna?
clues: Danu dund bu yàgg, ab ndaw diw ci nun, mu jóge sunu biir.
Jaamu nanu juróomi xër te bañoon a bàyyi leen.
Nu ñaawal ndaw si, jiiñ ko ne dafa réer.
Nu laaj ko mu indi mbugal mi sudee dëgg lay wax.
Nu gis asamaan di taw, suuf si di génne ay ndox.
Nu yéeg ca bérab yu kawe yi ngir rëcci, waaye duus yi daal di nu xëcc.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Mbënd mu rëy moo nu mbëgg
Benn bomb bu am doole moo nu ray
Dañu nu sànni xeer ci asamaan si
trial.answer: Mbënd mu rëy moo nu mbëgg

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Nun ñépp lanu sànku, lu moy ñi gëm ak Nuh
Ñu bàyyi nu nu nekk mbalit ngir tukkikat yi
outcome.answer: Nun ñépp lanu sànku, lu moy ñi gëm ak Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
